Meet Emily

About

Trusted Tails has been around for over seven years now, caring for dogs, cats, reptiles, small animals, and the occasional farm friend in Westminster and Boulder. Animals have always made sense to me, more than most things do, and that's only gotten stronger with every year of hands-on experience.

Whether you're gone for a few hours or a whole week, I make sure your pets feel safe and comfortable at home. I've taken dog training classes and worked with a lot of different animals, so leash walks, medication schedules, cleaning up little messes, reading a nervous pet's mood, it's all part of the job. A high-energy dog and a shy cat get the exact same level of attention.

I do this because I love it. Animals deserve patience and kindness, and that's what they get every time Trusted Tails shows up.

Every pet is treated like my own.
Emily, Founder & Owner
